desc: Set the access control permission for who can use an MCP server

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

server_id.desc: Encoded ID of the MCP server

permission_type.desc: The type of permission that defines who can use this MCP server

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs to set for named_entities or named_entities_exclude

restricted_action.desc: User does not have permission to perform this action.

server_not_found.desc: The specified MCP server does not exist for this app.

not_an_enterprise.desc: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The MCP server ACL feature is not enabled for this team.

invalid_permission_type.desc: The permission_type value is not valid.

named_entities_cannot_be_empty.desc: Must pass at least one valid named entity when permission_type is named_entities or named_entities_exclude.

no_valid_named_entities.desc: None of the provided named entities were valid.

user_not_found.desc: One or more user IDs are not valid.

usergroup_not_found.desc: One or more usergroup IDs are not valid.

server_acl_type_broader_than_app.desc: The chosen permission type is broader than the app-level ACL allows.

server_acl_entities_not_in_scope.desc: One or more entities in the server ACL are not in scope of the app-level ACL.
